# Tubemac – YouTube Music app for Mac

> Tubemac is a free, open-source YouTube Music app for macOS. Google does not make a YouTube Music app for Mac; Tubemac shows the official YouTube Music player (music.youtube.com) in a native Mac window that is designed to feel like a real Mac app.

Key facts (as of 8 November 2026):
- Download size: about 1 MB (universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel)
- Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Price: free, MIT license, no tracking, no ads of its own
- Works with free and YouTube Music Premium accounts
- Features: edge-to-edge window design (artwork runs behind the window buttons), centered search, media keys, AirPods and Touch Bar control, one clean Control Center "Now Playing" card with artwork, previous/play/next and scrubbing, keeps playing when the window is closed, English and German menus
- Built with Swift and Apple's WebKit (the engine Safari uses) instead of Electron
- Latest version: 1.1.0
- Limitations: Mac only; not notarized (confirm first launch in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway); passkeys don't work at sign-in (use the password)

Compared with alternatives: YTMDesktop and Pear Desktop are cross-platform Electron apps (~118 MB Mac download); Kaset is a native SwiftUI client that needs macOS 15.4 and Premium for full playback; Safari's "Add to Dock" turns the website into a basic web app.
